title: Dad Cap from $3 + Delivery ($0 C&C/ in Limited Stores/ $65 Order) @ Kmart
body:
Deal: Dad Cap from $3 + Delivery ($0 C&C/ in Limited Stores/ $65 Order) @ Kmart

[EBC] Wesfarmers really gutting the value of Onepass by excluding clearance items. Getting closer and closer to not being worth it.
[DingoBlue] What's the cheapest non-clearance item you can add?
[EBC] Don't think it works that way. If you add a clearance items to the cart with non clearance stuff you get charged the delivery fee even with Onepass.
[Laziofogna] It's weird because they can deliver a $1 item no worries, but a clearance $20 no way.
[BestTechAdvisor] I'd rather the $56. K shaped economy and all that.
[Moventura] Wait, we have a cap on being a dad now? Whats this world coming to? This is all Dan Andrews fault.
[joeyg4343] Anyone in Toowoomba wanting to buy this message me I'll give you a cap for free.
[xyzzyxyzzy] Don't know why people want to wear SOHO LONDON or CALIFORNIA on their bare scalp
